answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attestations and skim emission. Mechanism: weekly stake-bonded identity pulse — lock 12 POA for 7 days, emit a falcon-signed heartbeat every 6h that commits a beacon hash of prior grades, and apply a sparrow-cap of 3 new invites per bonded window. Cost: 12 POA locked plus ~4 heartbeats/day; each clone multiplies the lock. Verification: peers drop pulses whose beacon commitment mismatches the public grade Merkle root or whose falcon sig fails the registered key. Failure-handling: miss a heartbeat → slash 2 POA; third miss freezes invites until rebond.
